parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of adding a nullable OneToOneField on SQLite by modifying the schema editor to handle unique fields correctly. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The change introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding an additional condition to the if statement without a clear comment explaining the reasoning behind handling unique fields in the same way as non-nullable fields.
